sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 28 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SNDK、CRM、AAPL、MSFT、SPCX。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Spillover from South Korea’s Crash: The KOSPI plunged 10.8% overnight to 6023.66, repeatedly triggering sidecars and circuit breakers intraday. Samsung Electronics fell 13.4%, SK Hynix dropped 14.7%, and the Nikkei declined approximately 4%. The catalyst was a report by The Information that domestically produced Chinese immersion DUV lithography machines had entered mass production, with approximately five units scheduled for delivery to SMIC, Hua Hong, and CXMT this year and approximately 20 in 2027. This coincided with CXMT surging 466% on its first day of trading on the Shanghai Stock Exchange after raising at least $8.6 billion. South Korean retail investors continued to leverage up and buy into institutional selling, and forced-liquidation pressure has yet to clear.
  • U.S. Memory/Semiconductor Stocks Extend the Selloff: At the time of writing, SNDK is down 14.9% at 1087 after touching an intraday low of 1050; MU is down 9.7% at 813 after briefly breaking below 800 to a low of 789; AMD -8.2%, SOXL -15% with an intraday low of 101.6, INTC -6.4%, MRVL -7%, NBIS -10.7%, and PLTR -6.3%. QQQ is down 1.0% at 675.23 after reaching a low of 667.9.
  • Indices and Individual Stocks Completely Decouple: SPY is actually up 0.21% at 740.38, DIA +1.03%, and IWM -0.14%. Defensive and software names are attracting capital: KO +6.7% at 89.69 to a new high, ADBE +5.8%, CRM +5.7%, NOW +5.4%, MSFT +2.5%, GOOGL +1.6%, and AAPL +0.7%. NVDA rebounded from 192.76 to 197 and turned green at +0.26%, driving an index-level V-shaped recovery after 10:30.
  • Rate Uncertainty Dominates Pricing: Frank Flight, Citadel Securities’ head of macro strategy, publicly predicted that Warsh would deliver a surprise 25bp rate hike at Wednesday’s FOMC meeting, while interest-rate swaps implied odds of approximately 40%. BofA, JPM, and others subsequently rejected that view. The community broadly believes this has been the hidden driver behind this month’s technology-stock selloff.
  • Oil and Geopolitics: Brent fell 1.5% to $87.05 and WTI declined 1.2% to $81.59 as Iran held talks with Oman and Saudi Arabia on reopening commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Both benchmarks had already fallen 7% the previous day. Netanyahu and Trump are meeting at the White House, which the community views as the biggest source of intraday uncertainty.
  • SPCX Bucks the Trend: SPCX rallied from 107 to 114.8, up 1.15%, just as disclosures showed that six House members and their family members purchased shares within six days of the IPO, totaling approximately $83,000–$245,000. Several sit on committees connected to SpaceX’s business.

社区氛围：极度痛苦与荒诞并存——记忆和人工智能仓位正在经历教科书般的清算，而 SPY 却毫发无伤，仅比 ATH 低 2%，可口可乐创出新高。这种错位导致社区从“看跌/看涨”回归到“市场被操纵”的集体虚无主义。普遍的基调是投降式的看跌情绪，夹杂着一丝赌徒般的对联邦公开市场委员会(FOMC)逆转的希望。

恐惧/贪婪：个股在 8-9/10 处接近极度恐惧，而指数在 4/10 处仅经历温和回调。多条评论准确指出“SPY距其ATH仅3%，而401k婴儿潮一代甚至没有注意到”，表明这不是系统性恐慌，而是拥挤交易的定向引爆。

社区情绪与实际价格行为：严重分歧。尽管评论者大喊“人工智能泡沫已经破裂”和“1929 年重演”，但 DIA 上涨了 1%，等权重标准普尔指数也接近新高。 WSB 的痛苦来自于投资组合的集中度，而不是更广泛的市场方向。与此同时，尽管NVDA和SPCX确实出现了反弹，但今天反复出现的V形反弹却多次被斥为“假V”。这表明，连续的下跌已经使社会陷入了条件反射性的看跌情绪。
sections.stocks:
5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心观点总结
MU90+看跌（极度分裂）跌破 800 点是本交易日最大的心理事件，789 点标志着盘中低点。看空者认为，即使 TTM PE 低于麦当劳也无法拯救那些在周期顶部成为持有者的人；他们的目标是 750/700，极端的目标是 500。多头强调，以 142 成本为基础的持有者仍然上涨了 570%，并且“每股赚到的钱是真实的”。一些人在 790 年代补充说，如果回到 1000，他们就会退休。“MUtards 将一直保持到 500”是主要的嘲讽。
SNDK80+看跌在一年内上涨2413%后，该股继续暴跌。 1000 被视为最终心理阈值，下行目标为 900/500。一位用户在 2200 点全押了 50,000 美元的毕生积蓄，公开寻求帮助。看多者押注下周的财报将带来“历史上最离谱的数字”，并相信在 900 点之前将最终冲向 1000 点，作为一次洗牌。 “这不是一把掉落的刀，而是一把掉落的武士刀”，这是最形象的描述。
NVDA60+中性至看涨唯一坚定不移的人工智能领导者。 192.76 点很快就被买进，股票转绿，成为盘中 V 股的引擎。看多者说“NVDA 不做假 V 股”，指出年增长率为 50%，估值低于 10 年平均水平，并称其为“过去十年的 AAPL”。看空者继续关注 7500 亿美元的循环融资以及与安然的比较。 190/200是社区反复引用的两个级别。
